scope: Phase 21: review phase19/20 architecture, then fix the demonstrated empty TTS pool recovery dead end. Overall voice optimization is incomplete.

retain: Candidate assembly remains exclusively in UserTurnCoordinator; endpointing_text is a guarded read-only lookup, not a second merger.
InterruptAwareTurnDetector uses public ChatContext copies and SpeechHandle completion; the SDK remains responsible for score-based endpointing, final submission and playback scheduling.
Default none does not enable the optional model; half duplex, PTT and native adaptive ownership remain outside the adapter.
architecture_review.correction_to_work_direction: Stop repeated intent label/prompt experiments; rejected candidates were only temporary and never entered production. No unnecessary production prompt implementation exists to remove.
architecture_review.limit: This review covers current phase19/20 changes and relevant TTS lifecycle, not a fresh line-by-line approval of all 112 files in commit 67cf3b0.

evidence_from_phase20.fast_half_duplex: ASR WebSocket opening handshake timed out; channel emitted non-retryable APIError and the SDK recreated the stream.
evidence_from_phase20.correction: Intent warmup and current classification timed out; the existing noninterruptible speech guard skipped the reply.
evidence_from_phase20.stop: All 3 bootstrap TTS connections failed; subsequent acquire waited 12s with in_flight=0.
evidence_from_phase20.qualification: These are observed failure paths, not proof all failures share a cause. STT close timeout remains unresolved.

production_change.root_cause: The bounded-mode empty-queue branch waited for an item without invoking the existing producer scheduler. Total warmup failure or a completed failed refill left neither a warm connection nor a running producer, so retries repeated an idle queue wait.
production_change.fix: Call existing _maybe_refill() before bounded queue wait. No new scheduler, task type, connection pool, retry loop, timeout, threshold, model, dependency or conversation policy.
production_change.limits: Existing deficit calculation, failure backoff, acquire deadline and SDK retry remain. A provider outage can still fail; recovery is initiated on a subsequent acquire, not promised during an ongoing outage. Legacy inline mode and healthy fast path are unchanged.
production_change.cleanup: Removed one pre-existing unused Optional import flagged by Ruff in the touched module.

controlled_tests.provenance: Real production pipelines, AgentSession, Bailian TTS stream, aggregator and pool. STT/LLM and TTS network client are test doubles. This is controlled end-to-end orchestration, not a real cloud latency sample.
controlled_tests.baseline_method: A temporary pytest fixture uses the committed HEAD acquire method against the same final test input; workspace production code stays at the fix. All three fail with empty queue/in_flight=0.
controlled_tests.fixture_correction: An initial test import failed, then a short request also hit existing EOT wait. The final fixture reuses an already validated complete request. Baseline and after use exactly the same final fixture; no production threshold/deadline changes.
